function.name: impl_from_IDataObject
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IDataObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IDataObject interface

function.return_type: DataCache* - Pointer to the containing record of type DataCache

function.name: impl_from_IUnknown
function.description: This function returns the containing record for a given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: DataCache, which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IPersistStorage
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IPersistStorage interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IPersistStorage interface.

function.return_type: DataCache pointer, representing the containing record for the given IPersistStorage interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IViewObject2
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface, specifically the DataCache record that contains the IViewObject2 interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IViewObject2 interface

function.return_type: DataCache pointer, representing the containing record for the given interface

function.name: impl_from_IOleCache2
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a DataCache structure that contains the given IOleCache2 interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IOleCache2 interface.

function.return_type: DataCache pointer, which represents the DataCache structure that contains the given IOleCache2 interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IOleCacheControl
function.description: This function returns the DataCache object that contains the IOleCacheControl interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleCacheControl interface

function.return_type: DataCache *: Pointer to the DataCache object that contains the IOleCacheControl interface

function.name: impl_from_IAdviseSink
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the DataCache structure that contains the given IAdviseSink interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IAdviseSink interface

function.return_type: DataCache pointer, represents the DataCache structure that contains the IAdviseSink interface pointer

function.name: debugstr_formatetc
function.description: This function returns a formatted string representing the contents of a FORMATETC structure.

parameters.name: formatetc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a FORMATETC structure that needs to be represented as a string.

function.return_type: char: This function returns a pointer to a string that represents the contents of the FORMATETC structure.

function.name: bitmap_info_size
function.description: This function calculates the size of a bitmap information structure, taking into account the color usage and the type of bitmap header.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the bitmap.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies the type of color indexes used by the bitmap. This can be either DIB_RGB_COLORS or DIB_PAL_COLORS.

function.return_type: int, represents the size of the bitmap information structure in bytes.

function.name: DataCacheEntry_Destroy
function.description: This function removes a cache entry from the list, frees the memory allocated for the format etc. pointer, releases the storage medium, and if the sink_id is not null, unadvises the running object. Finally, it frees the memory allocated for the cache entry.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache from which the entry is to be removed.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the cache entry that is to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything.

function.name: DataCache_Destroy
function.description: This function releases the sink interface and presentation storage if they are not null, destroys the data cache entries and finally frees the data cache pointer.

parameters.name: ptrToDestroy
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache to be destroyed

function.return_type: void, does not return anything

function.name: DataCache_GetEntryForFormatEtc
function.description: This function searches for a cache entry that matches the specified format in the data cache. If the format is a bitmap, it changes the format to DIB and sets the tymed to TYMED_HGLOBAL. It then iterates over the cache list and returns the first entry that matches the format, aspect, lindex, and tymed of the specified format.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DataCache object where the function will search for the entry.

parameters.name: formatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that specifies the format, medium, and target device that the function uses when searching for the entry.

function.return_type: DataCacheEntry pointer. It represents the first cache entry that matches the specified format. If no such entry is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: get_static_entry
function.description: This function retrieves a static entry from a data cache. If the first entry in the cache has an id of 1, it is returned and the function returns S_OK. Otherwise, the function returns E_FAIL.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: A pointer to the data cache from which to retrieve the entry.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a data cache entry. This is where the function will store the retrieved entry.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the first entry in the cache has an id of 1, otherwise returns E_FAIL.

function.name: check_valid_formatetc
function.description: This function checks if the provided FORMATETC structure is valid or not.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure to be checked.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can return S_OK if the format is valid, DV_E_FORMATETC if the dwAspect is DVASPECT_ICON and cfFormat is not CF_METAFILEPICT, CACHE_S_FORMATETC_NOTSUPPORTED if tymed is TYMED_HGLOBAL, or DV_E_TYMED if the clipformat/tymed combination is invalid.

function.name: init_cache_entry
function.description: This function initializes a cache entry by copying the format, setting the storage medium, id, dirty flag, load and save stream numbers, sink id, and advise flags.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the cache entry to be initialized

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the format to be copied to the cache entry

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advise flags to be set in the cache entry

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id to be set in the cache entry

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the cache entry is successfully initialized, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: DataCache_CreateEntry
function.description: This function creates a new entry in the data cache. It first checks if the formatetc is valid, then allocates memory for a new entry and initializes it. If the automatic flag is set, the new entry is added to the head of the cache list, otherwise it is added to the tail. If the cache_entry pointer is not null, it is set to the new entry. If any step fails, it frees the allocated memory and returns an error.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DataCache structure where the new entry will be created

parameters.name: formatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that describes the format, medium, and target device for notification

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Specifies a group of flags for controlling the caching

parameters.name: automatic
parameters.description: Flag that determines whether the new entry is added to the head (if TRUE) or tail (if FALSE) of the cache list

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that will be set to the new entry, if it is not null

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It can be a success code, an error code or a specific result code depending on the function's execution

function.name: DataCache_FireOnViewChange
function.description: This function sends notifications to a sink when the sink's filter matches the aspect. If the sink's advise flag is set to ADVF_ONLYONCE, the sink is unregistered after the first notification.

parameters.name: this
parameters.description: Pointer to the DataCache object

parameters.name: aspect
parameters.description: Aspect to be matched with the sink's filter

parameters.name: lindex
parameters.description: Index used in the IAdviseSink_OnViewChange function

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: read_clipformat
function.description: This function reads a clipboard format from a stream. If the length of the clipboard format is -1, it reads a DWORD from the stream. If the length is not -1, it reads a string from the stream and registers it as a clipboard format.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The stream from which the clipboard format is read.

parameters.name: clipformat
parameters.description: The clipboard format that is read from the stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, DV_E_CLIPFORMAT if the read operation fails or the read length does not match the expected length, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: write_clipformat
function.description: This function writes the clipboard format to a stream. If the clipboard format is less than 0xc000, it writes the format directly. Otherwise, it retrieves the clipboard format name and writes it to the stream.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The stream where the clipboard format is to be written.

parameters.name: clipformat
parameters.description: The clipboard format that is to be written to the stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: open_pres_stream
function.description: This function opens a presentation stream in a given storage object and returns a pointer to the stream interface.

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage object where the stream is located.

parameters.name: stream_number
parameters.description: The number of the stream to be opened.

parameters.name: stm
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a stream interface. This will be filled with the opened stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the stream number is not set or is set to contents, it returns E_FAIL. Otherwise, it returns the result of the IStorage_OpenStream function.

function.name: synthesize_emf
function.description: This function synthesizes an enhanced metafile from a given metafile picture and stores it in a storage medium.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: This is the input metafile picture that needs to be synthesized.

parameters.name: med
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the storage medium where the synthesized enhanced metafile will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns E_FAIL.

function.name: load_mf_pict
function.description: This function loads a metafile picture from a stream into a cache entry. It reads the stream, allocates memory for the picture, and sets the picture's properties. If the operation is successful, it stores the picture in the cache entry. If it fails, it cleans up any allocated resources.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: A pointer to a cache entry where the loaded metafile picture will be stored.

parameters.name: stm
parameters.description: A pointer to a stream from which the metafile picture will be read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or E_FAIL if setting the metafile bits fails.

function.name: load_dib
function.description: This function loads a device-independent bitmap (DIB) from a stream into a cache entry. It reads the bitmap information header, allocates memory for the bitmap, reads the bitmap data from the stream into the allocated memory, and updates the cache entry with the loaded bitmap.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: A pointer to the cache entry where the loaded bitmap will be stored.

parameters.name: stm
parameters.description: A pointer to the stream from which the bitmap will be read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: load_emf
function.description: This function loads an Enhanced Metafile (EMF) into a cache entry from a given stream. It handles two different scenarios based on the stream number in the cache entry.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to a DataCacheEntry structure where the EMF will be loaded.

parameters.name: stm
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface from which the EMF will be read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, an error code or a warning code.

function.name: DataCacheEntry_LoadData
function.description: This function loads data from a storage into a cache entry. It opens a stream from the storage, checks the format of the cache entry, and loads the data accordingly. It releases the stream after loading the data.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the cache entry where the data will be loaded

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage from where the data will be loaded

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns specific error codes in case of failure, otherwise a success code.

function.name: init_stream_header
function.description: This function initializes the stream header by setting its properties based on the given data cache entry and presentation data header.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the data cache entry from which values are retrieved to set the properties of the stream header.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the presentation data header that is being initialized.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the given presentation data header.

function.name: save_dib
function.description: This function saves a device-independent bitmap (DIB) into a stream. It first checks if the storage medium type is not NULL, then it calculates the size of the data and locks it. If the contents flag is false, it writes the clip format and the header into the stream. If the contents flag is true, it writes the bitmap file header and the data into the stream. Finally, it unlocks the global memory block.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache entry that contains the bitmap information.

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: Flag that indicates whether to write the contents or not.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the bitmap will be saved.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: save_mfpict
function.description: This function saves a metafile picture (MFPict) to a stream. If the 'contents' parameter is false, it writes the clip format and presentation header to the stream. If 'contents' is true, it writes a metafile to the stream.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache entry that contains the metafile picture to be saved.

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to write the metafile to the stream (true) or the clip format and presentation header (false).

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the metafile picture or its header will be written.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, DV_E_STGMEDIUM if it fails to lock the metafile picture, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if it fails to allocate memory for the data.

function.name: save_emf
function.description: This function saves an Enhanced Metafile (EMF) to a stream. It handles two scenarios: when contents are not required, it writes the clip format to the stream and retrieves the metafile bits, allocating memory as needed. If contents are required and the storage medium type is not NULL, it retrieves the enhanced metafile bits, allocates memory, and writes the data to the stream.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache entry which contains the metafile to be saved

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contents are required or not

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the metafile will be saved

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation failed, or other error codes depending on the failure

function.name: save_view_cache
function.description: This function initializes a stream header, writes the clip format to the stream, and then writes the header to the stream.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache entry to be saved

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the data cache entry will be written

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or failure

function.name: create_stream
function.description: This function creates a stream with a specific name in a given storage. The name of the stream is either 'CONTENTS' or a string derived from the save_stream_num of the cache_entry, depending on the value of the contents parameter.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to a DataCacheEntry structure. It is used to derive the name of the stream when contents is FALSE.

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStorage interface. The stream is created in this storage.

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: Boolean value that determines the name of the stream. If TRUE, the stream name is 'CONTENTS'. If FALSE, the stream name is derived from the save_stream_num of the cache_entry.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IStream interface. The created stream is returned in this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: DataCacheEntry_Save
function.description: This function saves the data cache entry to a stream. It creates a stream, checks the format of the cache entry, and calls the appropriate save function based on the format. It releases the stream and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache entry to be saved

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage where the stream will be created

parameters.name: same_as_load
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the save operation is the same as the load operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: copy_stg_medium
function.description: This function copies a STGMEDIUM structure. If the structure contains a metafile picture, it duplicates the metafile picture handle. If the structure contains other data, it duplicates the data using the OLE function OleDuplicateData.

parameters.name: cf
parameters.description: The clipboard format used for the data.

parameters.name: dest_stgm
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination STGMEDIUM structure.

parameters.name: src_stgm
parameters.description: Pointer to the source STGMEDIUM structure.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, DV_E_STGMEDIUM if the source STGMEDIUM structure does not contain a valid metafile picture, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is insufficient memory to complete the operation.

function.name: synthesize_dib
function.description: This function synthesizes a device-independent bitmap (DIB) from a given bitmap and stores it in a STGMEDIUM structure.

parameters.name: bm
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap to be synthesized into a DIB.

parameters.name: med
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure where the synthesized DIB will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the function succeeds and E_FAIL if it fails.

function.name: synthesize_bitmap
function.description: This function synthesizes a bitmap using a device-independent bitmap (DIB) and a storage medium (STGMEDIUM). It locks the DIB, creates a bitmap with the DIB and bitmap information, unlocks the DIB, and sets the type of the storage medium to TYMED_GDI. If successful, it returns S_OK; otherwise, it returns E_FAIL.

parameters.name: dib
parameters.description: Handle to a global memory object. It is used to create a device-independent bitmap.

parameters.name: med
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure. It is used to provide a generalized means of transferring data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value is E_FAIL.

function.name: DataCacheEntry_SetData
function.description: This function sets the data for a cache entry, handling different formats and storage mediums. It also handles the release of storage medium if necessary.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the cache entry to set data for

parameters.name: formatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to the format descriptor for the data

parameters.name: stgmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage medium structure

parameters.name: fRelease
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to release the storage medium

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful, DV_E_FORMATETC if the format descriptor is invalid, or the result of the copy_stg_medium function

function.name: DataCacheEntry_GetData
function.description: This function retrieves data from a cache entry, loads data if necessary, and handles different formats of data.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the cache entry from which data is to be retrieved

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage where the data is to be loaded from if necessary

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the format in which the data is expected

parameters.name: stgmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage medium where the retrieved data is to be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns the status of the data loading operation if data loading is necessary, OLE_E_BLANK if the storage medium type is TYMED_NULL, the status of bitmap synthesis operation if the format is CF_BITMAP, or the status of the storage medium copying operation otherwise.

function.name: DataCacheEntry_DiscardData
function.description: This function releases the storage medium associated with the given data cache entry.

parameters.name: cache_entry
parameters.description: A pointer to the data cache entry whose associated storage medium is to be released.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, with S_OK indicating success.

function.name: tymed_from_cf
function.description: This function takes a DWORD parameter and returns a corresponding DWORD value based on the input. It uses a switch case to determine the return value.

parameters.name: cf
parameters.description: This parameter is used as the input for the switch case to determine the return value.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents different types of medium (TYMED_GDI, TYMED_MFPICT, TYMED_ENHMF, TYMED_HGLOBAL) based on the input cf.

function.name: create_automatic_entry
function.description: This function creates an automatic entry in a data cache. It checks if the provided CLSID is equal to the cache's CLSID. If they are equal, the function returns S_OK. If not, it moves and reassigns any pre-existing automatic entry. Then, it iterates through a static data array to find a match for the provided CLSID. If a match is found, it creates a new entry in the cache and sets the cache's clsid_static to TRUE. If no match is found, it sets the cache's clsid_static to FALSE and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Pointer to the data cache where the automatic entry will be created

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID that will be used to create the automatic entry

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: DataCache_NDIUnknown_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a data cache object. It checks the interface ID (IID) and returns the corresponding interface if it is supported. If the requested interface is not supported, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported and returned successfully, E_NOINTERFACE if the interface is not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL

function.name: DataCache_NDIUnknown_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a DataCache object

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IUnknown interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment

function.name: DataCache_NDIUnknown_Release
function.description: This function releases the data cache by decrementing the reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, it destroys the data cache.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the data cache implementation.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the reference count after decrementing.

function.name: DataCache_IDataObject_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a data object and returns the interface requested in ppvObject.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the data object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If the interface is not supported, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: DataCache_IDataObject_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to a DataCache object through the IDataObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface through which the DataCache object is accessed.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the addition.

function.name: DataCache_IDataObject_Release
function.description: This function releases the IDataObject interface from the DataCache object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the IDataObject interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the DataCache object after the IDataObject interface has been released.

function.name: DataCache_GetData
function.description: This function retrieves data from the cache based on the specified format and stores it in the provided storage medium.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object.

parameters.name: pformatetcIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device to use when passing the data.

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to the STGMEDIUM structure which indicates the storage medium containing the data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or specific type of failure.

function.name: DataCache_GetDataHere
function.description: This function is currently a stub and not implemented. It is supposed to get data from a cache.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to the STGMEDIUM structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, in this case it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented

function.name: DataCache_QueryGetData
function.description: This function queries the data from the cache based on the format provided.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the format of the data to be retrieved

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the cache entry is found, otherwise returns S_FALSE

function.name: DataCache_GetCanonicalFormatEtc
function.description: This function is a placeholder that currently does not implement any functionality.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object

parameters.name: pformatectIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the input format

parameters.name: pformatetcOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output format

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Currently always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: DataCache_IDataObject_SetData
function.description: This function sets data on an IDataObject interface, queries the interface for IOleCache2, and sets data on the obtained IOleCache2.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject interface where the data is to be set.

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device to use for the data object.

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure that defines the storage medium in which the data is being passed.

parameters.name: fRelease
parameters.description: Boolean value that indicates whether the function should release the storage medium after setting the data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_UNEXPECTED if the IDataObject_QueryInterface call fails, otherwise it returns the result of IOleCache2_SetData.

function.name: DataCache_EnumFormatEtc
function.description: This function is a placeholder that currently does not implement any functionality.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object

parameters.name: dwDirection
parameters.description: Specifies the direction of the data

parameters.name: ppenumFormatEtc
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a FORMATETC enumerator

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Currently always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: DataCache_DAdvise
function.description: This function is used to advise the data cache. However, it is not supported and always returns OLE_E_ADVISENOTSUPPORTED.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the data object

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advisory flags

parameters.name: pAdvSink
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface on the advise sink

parameters.name: pdwConnection
parameters.description: Pointer to a token that can be used to identify the advise connection

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns OLE_E_ADVISENOTSUPPORTED indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: DataCache_DUnadvise
function.description: This function is used to remove an advise sink that was previously set up.

parameters.name: iface

function.name: add_cache_entry
function.description: This function adds a new entry to the data cache. If the entry does not exist, it creates a new one. It also sets the load and save stream numbers for the cache entry and marks it as not dirty.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DataCache object where the entry is to be added.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device that the new cache entry can accept.

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advise flags. This parameter is used when creating a new cache entry.

parameters.name: stream_number
parameters.description: The stream number to be set for the load and save operations of the cache entry.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an HRESULT error code.

function.name: parse_pres_streams
function.description: This function parses presentation streams from a given storage and adds them to a cache. It reads the clip format and header from each stream, and if successful, it creates a FORMATETC structure and adds it to the cache. The function continues to parse streams until it encounters a failure or there are no more streams.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: A pointer to the cache where parsed streams will be added.

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: A pointer to the storage from where the streams will be read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. If the function executes successfully, it returns S_OK.

function.name: parse_contents_stream
function.description: This function opens a stream, gets a static entry from the cache, assigns stream numbers to the cache entry and sets its dirty flag to FALSE. It releases the stream before returning.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Pointer to a DataCache object, used to get a static entry and assign stream numbers

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStorage object, used to open a stream

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operations performed in the function. If any operation fails, the function returns the error code.

function.name: DataCache_Load
function.description: This function loads data from a storage into a cache. It also handles errors and sets the cache's class ID and presentation storage.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the persistent storage object

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Storage from which data is to be loaded

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: DataCache_Save
function.description: This function assigns stream numbers to the cache entries and writes out the cache entries. It also checks if the save stream number is different from the stream number, and if so, marks the cache entry as dirty. If the cache entry is dirty or if it's not the same as load, the function attempts to save the cache entry. If the save operation fails, it breaks the loop. If it's the same as load, it marks the cache entry and the DataCache as not dirty.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used to get the implementation of DataCache

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage where the cache entries are to be saved

parameters.name: same_as_load
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the save operation is the same as the load operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the save operation. If the save operation is successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise, it returns the error code

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to access the DataCache object.

parameters.name: dwConnection
parameters.description: This is the connection ID of the cache entry to be removed.

function.return_type: HRESULT. This represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the cache entry is found and successfully removed, and OLE_E_NOCONNECTION if the cache entry is not found.

function.name: DataCache_EnumCache
function.description: This function enumerates the cache data. It counts the number of entries in the cache list, allocates memory for the data, and then copies the format, advise flags, and connection ID from each cache entry to the data. If the format of the cache entry is CF_DIB, it creates an additional entry with format CF_BITMAP and tymed TYMED_GDI. If the function fails at any point, it frees the memory allocated for the data and returns the HRESULT from the failed operation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleCache2 interface

parameters.name: enum_stat
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumSTATDATA interface, which will receive the enumerated cache data

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the HRESULT from the failed operation if any other operation fails.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails during the discarding of cache entry data, it returns the error code.
